task: My grandpa Walt passed last Tuesday at 91. He farmed corn in Iowa for 50 years and taught me to fish on Miller's Pond. Can you help me write a 3-minute eulogy I can read at the funeral Saturday at St. Mark's?

Our HOA sent me a violation notice saying my mailbox post needs to be repainted black, but I already have it painted the color listed in the covenants from 2019. Write a polite letter to the board asking them to reinspect and withdraw the fine of $75.
I'm a 34-year-old ER nurse who loves trivia nights, sourdough, and long walks with my beagle. Write a short, funny dating profile for Hinge, under 500 characters, that doesn't sound cheesy.

I'm the snack coordinator for my son's T-ball team and need to send a signup email to 14 families. Please write something friendly that explains we need one snack per game for the next 6 Saturdays and that we're keeping it nut-free.

I'm starting a mystery book club at the Eastside branch library and want to invite my neighbors. Write an invitation for our first meeting on November 8 at 7pm, where we'll discuss 'The Thursday Murder Club' and everyone brings a snack to share.

I'm co-chairing the PTA fall bake sale at Lincoln Elementary on Friday, Oct 31 from 8 to 10am. Write an announcement for the school newsletter asking parents to donate baked goods, with a note that items need labels for allergens.

My husband and I are doing a big garage sale on Saturday, November 1, starting at 8am at 412 Cedar Lane. Write a Facebook neighborhood group post listing that we have kids' bikes, a patio set, and lots of kitchen stuff, and that cash only.

Our neighbor's 13-year-old golden retriever Biscuit died this morning. I want to write a short handwritten card to go in her mailbox tomorrow, something warm that mentions how Biscuit always waited for the mail carrier.

My niece Priya turns 9 this Sunday and she's obsessed with horses and the Harry Potter books. Write a short birthday card message from her Auntie Jo that I can write inside a card with a horse on the front.

I completely forgot my best friend Dana's birthday last Thursday and didn't call until today. I feel awful and want to text her an apology that owns it without groveling too much, and offer to take her to brunch this weekend.

I'm the Little League commissioner and I have to give a 2-minute opening speech at the end-of-season awards night at the Riverside fields on Saturday. Please write something encouraging about how the kids improved, thanks to the 22 volunteer coaches, and the new dugout sponsors.

We finally closed on our first house and are hosting a housewarming on Sunday, December 7 from 2 to 5pm. Write a text-style invitation for our group chat that says it's a potluck, we'll provide drinks, and to bring slippers because we just refinished the floors.

My daughter Maya missed her Chemistry unit test on Tuesday because she had strep throat and has a doctor's note. Write a short email to Mr. Okafor asking if she can take the make-up test next week and mention she has her notes ready.

The streetlight at the corner of Oak and 14th has been out for three weeks and it's dark enough that I nearly hit a kid on a bike last night. Write a letter to the city council asking for a repair date and mention the work order number 24-7731.

I'm the secretary for the Maple Street Community Garden and we have 6 unused plots that got reassigned from people who never showed up this season. Write a notice to post at the gate explaining that plots left empty past Nov 15 will go to the waitlist of 9 people.

I'm the director of the St. Anne's community choir and we have 5 new members joining tomorrow night's rehearsal. Write a warm welcome message I can read aloud before we start, mentioning we rehearse Tuesdays at 7pm and that our spring concert is in April.

My college roommate Kelsey is getting married in Charleston in June and I just found out I can't go because of a work commitment that I can't move. Write a text reply to her saying I'm devastated to miss it, I'll send a gift, and I'd love a video of the reception.

My grandmother Helen is turning 90 next Saturday and we're throwing her a family dinner at her favorite diner. Write a short card message from me, her oldest grandson, that mentions her bingo nights and her famous apple pie.

Our Scout troop 214 is selling popcorn tins to fund a trip to the state jamboree next summer, and the goal is $6,000. Write an announcement for the parents' email that lists the pickup date of November 22 at the church parking lot and the cash or Venmo options.

I'm organizing our neighborhood watch meeting on Thursday, November 6 at 7pm in the Hollow Creek clubhouse, and we've had a rash of car break-ins. Write a short post for the Nextdoor group encouraging people to come and say we'll cover locking cars and the new camera program.

A nurse named Renee took care of my mom in the cardiac unit at St. Luke's for 8 nights and was incredibly patient with her and with me. I want to write her a handwritten thank-you note that I can drop off at the front desk tomorrow.

I've left dirty dishes in the sink for two weeks and my roommate Tomas has been quietly washing them, which I just realized was super unfair. Write a note I can slide under his door apologizing and saying I'll do a full cleaning on Sunday.

My wife Lynn and I hit 25 years of marriage this Friday, and I want to write her a card that mentions our first date at the Fourth Street pizza place and that I'd marry her all over again. Please keep it under 150 words and not too sappy.

My best friend since fourth grade, Marcus, is moving to Portland next Monday and I want to send him a goodbye text that's heartfelt but also a little funny. Something about the time we got lost in Yellowstone and how I'm going to miss him, and that he owes me a visit.

I'm introducing the guest speaker, Dr. Anita Shah, at our Rotary club lunch on Wednesday. She's a pediatric dentist who started a free dental clinic for uninsured kids in Lake County, and I need a 90-second introduction.

The county library cut Saturday hours at our branch from 9am-5pm to 10am-2pm starting next month, and I think this hurts working parents. Write a letter to the editor of the Lakeside Herald, around 200 words, that asks the county commission to restore the hours.

Our Hope for Kids 5K on Saturday raised $11,400 and we had 312 runners, which is way more than last year. Write a recap post for our Instagram thanking the sponsors, volunteers, and the Ridgeview High cross-country team.

My son's daycare changed their pickup policy so that only people on the emergency list can pick up after 5:30pm, and my mother-in-law who lives with us isn't on it. Write a polite email to the director, Ms. Dawson, asking to add Carol Reyes to the list with her driver's license info sent separately.

My coworker Jen and her husband just had a baby girl named Lila at 6 lbs 2 oz, and I'm planning to send a card to the office. Write a short, sweet congratulations message for the card that's appropriate for a coworker I'm not super close with.

A high school senior named Aaliyah volunteered with my food pantry every Saturday for two years, and she's applying for a community service scholarship due December 1. Write a short reference letter from me as the pantry coordinator that highlights her reliability and that she ran our Thanksgiving drive by herself.
